caption:
Нека очилата ти говорят вместо теб.
Намери своя уникален стил в One Optic.

✨ Визуалът е създаден с AI.
prompt: Cinematic noir: near-black scene, one beam of light on a model in white tailoring, shallow depth of field, out-of-focus dark silhouettes in the foreground, glasses clearly lit. Calm dark lower area. A mysterious figure in their early 40s, partially obscured by deep shadows, a wisp of smoke curling gently in the dim, atmospheric light of a vintage-style bar. Only a sharp profile and the distinctive, bold black glasses are clearly visible. Dressed in a classic trench coat, the scene evokes intrigue and timeless cinema. Any person is an invented adult who does not resemble any real person. The glasses in the new image must be IDENTICAL to the reference photo: same shape, colour, proportions, temples and small details; never change, redraw or invent logos. The glasses are large, sharp and clearly visible. Premium luxury-campaign photograph, natural realistic skin and hands, correct anatomy. Do NOT render any text, logos, watermarks or letters anywhere in the image; leave calm space for a logo as described. No extra eyewear.
